name: Accordion · process steps
description: Numbered steps of how you work, one open at a time.

items.question: Discover
items.answer: We learn about your business, audience and goals in a kick-off workshop.

items.question: Define
items.answer: Together we agree on scope, success metrics and a realistic timeline.

items.question: Design
items.answer: Concepts, prototypes and reviews until everything feels right.

items.question: Build
items.answer: We develop, test and polish — with weekly demos along the way.

items.question: Launch & grow
items.answer: Go live, measure results and keep improving after launch.
